BJP Worker Hacked and Shot Dead in Malda; Family Alleges TMC Involvement

Samir Ghosh, a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) worker, was killed in Malda, West Bengal. He was reportedly hacked and shot at close range by a group of 11 individuals at his home. Malda police have arrested one suspect and are searching for the others. Ghosh's family has accused local Trinamool Congress (TMC) members of the murder, alleging it was politically motivated.
